# Maisé Studio

> Paris-based web design and development studio. We design and build bespoke,
> high-end websites for restaurants, cafés, hotels, clinics and boutiques —
> strategy, design and development under one roof, not templates.

## Services
- Custom web design and front-end development (no page builders, no templates)
- 3D / WebGL and motion-driven web experiences
- Multilingual websites (French, English, Turkish)
- Booking, online menu, and payment-flow integrations
- Search and AI-visibility optimization (classic SEO + generative-engine/AI-answer optimization)

## Who we build for
Cafés and restaurants, hotels and boutique hospitality, clinics and beauty
businesses, and independent retail brands — primarily in Paris and, for
pricing purposes, Turkey.
